message.content:
Finding #1  
(a) Endel and Plastikman released **“Deeper Focus: Remastered and Reduced”** as an expanded edition of the original Deeper Focus soundscape, launching via Endel apps on **May 21, 2026**; the new version adds deeper study/recovery/sleep depth modes and lets listeners shift in real time from techno to ambient via Endel’s adaptive AI engine while preserving Hawtin’s meticulous production standards.[1][3] Press coverage characterizes it as a neuroscience‑backed, AI-driven evolution of one of Endel’s top five soundscapes, updated five years after the original.[1][2][3]  
(b) Short quote: “The Berlin-based AI sound wellness company and the legendary Richie Hawtin alias return with ‘Deeper Focus: Remastered and Reduced’ — an expanded edition of one of Endel's top-five soundscapes, out May 21 via the Endel apps… Then on this expanded edition, the soundscape lets listeners tune their experience in real time — moving from techno to ambient on the fly through Endel’s adaptive AI engine.”[1]  
(c) Site/title: weraveyou.com – “Endel and Plastikman expand 'Deeper Focus' soundscape”[1]  
(d) Date: May 25, 2026 (article; expansion “out May 21”)[1]  
(e) URL: https://weraveyou.com/2026/05/endel-plastikman-deeper-focus-remastered-reduced/[1]  
Tag: [third-party]

Finding #2  
(a) Coverage of the 2026 expansion notes that after five years the Deeper Focus soundscape was updated with **three “depth modes”** for learning, recovery, and sleep, plus a new function to transition in real time between techno and ambient using Endel’s AI, explicitly framed as an upgrade of one of Endel’s most-used soundscapes (over 5 million hours played and top‑5 overall).[3]  
(b) Short quote (translated snippet): “5년만에 업데이트된 이번 버전에는 학습, 회복, 수면을 위한 세 가지 깊이 모드(depth modes)가 추가됐다. 또한 Endel의 기술을 활용해 테크노와 앰비언트 사이를 실시간으로 전환할 수 있는 기능도 새롭게 제공된다.”[3]  
(c) Site/title: mixing.co.kr – “Endel에서 AI 사운드스케이프 'Deeper Focus' 리마스터 공개 ...”[3]  
(d) Date: May 23, 2026[3]  
(e) URL: https://mixing.co.kr/40786[3]  
Tag: [third-party]

Finding #3  
(a) Press articles on the original **Endel × Plastikman: Deeper Focus** project describe Hawtin’s conceptual intent: to unite newly recorded Plastikman sounds, textures and rhythms with Endel’s AI to explore a new kind of collaboration between artist and technology, resulting in an AI‑powered personalized focus soundscape.[11]  
(b) Short quote: “The Deeper Focus mode unites newly recorded Plastikman sounds, textures and rhythms with the Endel AI, exploring a new type of collaboration between myself and technology.”[11]  
(c) Site/title: decodedmagazine.com – “Richie Hawtin aka Plastikman launches Deeper Focus, an AI-powered personalized soundscape”[11]  
(d) Date: April 23, 2021[11]  
(e) URL: https://www.decodedmagazine.com/richie-hawtin-aka-plastikman-launches-deeper-focus-an-ai-powered-personalized-soundscape/[11]  
Tag: [third-party]

Finding #4  
(a) A German feature on Deeper Focus quotes Hawtin explaining that the **Deeper Focus mode** combines newly recorded Plastikman sounds with Endel’s AI, emphasizing a collaborative experiment between human creativity and adaptive generative technology.[7]  
(b) Short quote: “Über „Deeper Focus“ sagt Hawtin: „Der Deeper-Focus-Modus vereint neu aufgenommene Plastikman-Sounds sowie Texturen und Rhythmen mit der Endel-AI und erforscht eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit zwischen mir und der Technologie.”[7]  
(c) Site/title: fazemag.de – “Personalisierte Klanglandschaften: Richie Hawtin & Endel präsentieren 'Deeper Focus'”[7]  
(d) Date: (page shows last updated November 3, 2025)[7]  
(e) URL: https://www.fazemag.de/personalisierte-klanglandschaften-richie-hawtin-endel-praesentieren-deeper-focus/[7]  
Tag: [third-party]

Finding #5  
(a) Endel’s dedicated **Deeper Focus** page positions the experience as original Plastikman sounds paired with **Endel AI** to create an “endless functional soundscape,” highlighting the generative, non‑static nature of the collaboration.[4]  
(b) Short quote: “Original sounds by Plastikman paired with Endel AI to create an endless functional soundscape.”[4]  
(c) Site/title: endel.io – “Endel × Plastikman: Deeper Focus”[4]  
(d) Date: page metadata lists April 2, 2021[4]  
(e) URL: https://deeper.endel.io/[4]  
Tag: [first-party]

Finding #6  
(a) The Google Play listing for Endel explicitly lists **“Plastikman: Deeper Focus – a deep focus techno soundscape created with Richie Hawtin”**, confirming the branding and function of the collaborative soundscape within the app’s catalog.[9]  
(b) Short quote: “• Plastikman: Deeper Focus – a deep focus techno soundscape created with Richie Hawtin”[9]  
(c) Site/title: play.google.com – “Endel: Focus, Relax & Sleep – Apps on Google Play”[9]  
(d) Date: listing last updated August 31, 2026[9]  
(e) URL: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.endel.endel&hl=en_US[9]  
Tag: [first-party]

Finding #7  
(a) The Japanese App Store description for Endel similarly highlights **Plastikman: Deeper Focus** as a deep focus techno soundscape created with Richie Hawtin, reinforcing that the soundscape is framed as functional focus content within Endel’s app ecosystem.[15]  
(b) Short quote: “- Plastikman: Deeper Focus - Richie Hawtinと制作したディープフォーカステクノサウンド”[15]  
(c) Site/title: apps.apple.com – “『Endel: Focus, Sleep, Relax』をApp Storeで”[15]  
(d) Date: listing dated September 26, 2022 (with later update metadata)[15]  
(e) URL: https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/endel-focus-sleep-relax/id1346247457[15]  
Tag: [first-party]

---

Finding #8  
(a) Endel CEO **Oleg Stavitsky** explains that Endel is “first and foremost a technology” that procedurally generates personalized soundscapes in real time on the device, using **stem‑based** audio and multiple AI systems; inputs include time of day, heart rate, weather, movement, circadian rhythms, and sleep history.[5]  
(b) Short quote: “The way this technology works, it procedurally generates a soundscape in real time on the spot, on the device. It is personalized to you based on a number of inputs that we collect about you; things like the time of day, your heart rate, the weather, your movement and your circadian rhythms, like how much sleep you got last night… The soundscapes are stem-based… The app has a huge library of samples and stems, and the algorithm picks the right stems to sequence the audio together… We have a few AI systems on top of that sequencer; AI systems that generate melodies basically. There are millions and millions and millions of variations.”[5]  
(c) Site/title: techcrunch.com – “Sony's new headphones boast Endel's generative ...”[5]  
(d) Date: May 20, 2022[5]  
(e) URL: https://techcrunch.com/2022/05/20/endel-sony-partnership/[5]  
Tag: [third-party] (contains extensive first‑party quotes)

Finding #9  
(a) In the same TechCrunch piece, Stavitsky describes how Endel works with artists like Grimes, Miguel, James Blake and Plastikman by having them deliver **stem packs or sound packs, not finished compositions**; the algorithm then assembles tracks on the fly from these building blocks, indicating a rules/AI‑driven generative process rather than static tracks.[5]  
(b) Short quote: “Some of the soundscapes on the app are done in collaboration with some of the biggest artists on the planet… The way they work with us is they prepare a stem pack, a sound pack. They never submit a musical composition. They just are the building blocks that the algorithm then uses to assemble tracks on the fly.”[5]  
(c) Site/title: techcrunch.com – “Sony's new headphones boast Endel's generative ...”[5]  
(d) Date: May 20, 2022[5]  
(e) URL: https://techcrunch.com/2022/05/20/endel-sony-partnership/[5]  
Tag: [third-party] (first‑party quotes)

Finding #10  
(a) An interview with Endel’s CEO on Athletech News reiterates that Endel’s app reacts to **time of day, weather, heart rate, and location** to create unique compositions, underscoring the adaptive generative engine that responds to environmental and biometric context.[8]  
(b) Short quote: “The app reacts to the time of day, weather, user heart rate and location to create unique compositions.”[8]  
(c) Site/title: athletechnews.com – “CEO Corner: Endel's Oleg Stavitsky on the Power of Functional Sound”[8]  
(d) Date: May 8, 2023[8]  
(e) URL: https://athletechnews.com/endel-ceo-oleg-stavitsky-exclusive-interview/[8]  
Tag: [third-party] (first‑party statements)

Finding #11  
(a) Endel’s presence in Amazon’s **Alexa Innovators** blog (2022 and 2023 posts) describes Endel’s patented technology as creating science‑backed functional soundscapes that help people relax, focus, and sleep, using inputs such as **movement, time of day, weather, heart rate, location**, and other factors, and then **using AI to generate personalized soundscapes that adapt in real time**.[10][13]  
(b) Short quote: “Endel’s award-winning patented technology creates science-backed, functional soundscapes that help people relax, focus, and sleep better. The technology takes inputs from the user's movement, time of day, weather, heart rate, location, and other factors. It then uses AI to generate personalized soundscapes that adapt to changes in real-time.”[13]  
(c) Site/title: developer.amazon.com – “Alexa Innovators: Endel”[13]  
(d) Date: August 3, 2022 (earlier post) and January 2023 (device makers CES 2023 post; date shown as January 2023)[13][10]  
(e) URL: https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/blogs/alexa/alexa-skills-kit/2022/08/alexa-innovators-endel[13]; https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/blogs/alexa/device-makers/2023/01/alexa-innovators-endel-ces-2023[10]  
Tag: [third-party] (first‑party positioning)

Finding #12  
(a) Apple’s newsroom feature on Endel’s app creator explains that Endel’s co‑founders designed an Apple Watch–native experience that uses inputs from the wearer’s environment—including **weather, heart rate, and exposure to natural light**—to build a personalized soundscape, emphasizing adaptive, context‑aware generation.[14]
